description: A later Ligue Iteka report links allegations against three CNL women to song/dance during an April 16 party anniversary gathering in Gitega, and Yaga also describes the gathering, but neither reviewed body establishes simultaneous attendance of at least 50. The three later arrests are not a crowd count.
required_followup: Seek contemporaneous reporting or organizer/official material that establishes actual gathering size and whether the song constituted a collective action; otherwise retain as an unresolved lead, not a coded event.

description: The April 16 CNL anniversary gathering is described with a song about famine, but reviewed accounts do not establish that it was a protest or that participants directed a demand to Burundi state authorities.
required_followup: If additional contemporaneous body evidence is identified, assess participants’ own demand and event character separately from the later arrest allegations; do not infer a state target from the official’s reaction.

description: The recorded English, French and Kirundi searches, local domains and specific Gitega lead are a bounded open-web pass, not comprehensive coverage of every province, source or archive.
required_followup: Pursue material province/sector leads if they arise; do not interpret absence from these search results as no events nationwide.
